> **IMPORTANT — VERIFY BEFORE RELYING ON ANY FIGURE**  
> This is an **intake aid only**, not a coverage determination, promise of payment, or substitute for the policy. The figures below come from older documented policy information. **They have not been revalidated for 2028.
